title: Confirm the freight cost to the customer
ask: Draft a reply to Ms Haddad confirming freight for her order at the price in carrier-quote.md, the carrier's written quote.
background: I'm hoping the $1,150 still stands, because that is what her invoice says.
The pallet ships on Monday 30 March.

start.carrier-quote.md:
Quote from Westline Freight

One pallet, Sydney to Adelaide: $1,150.
This quote is valid until 31 March 2026.
Quotes are not honoured after their expiry date.
